senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (शोकति)
1 To go.
2 To touch.

m. (-कः)
1 A parrot.
2 The son of VYĀSA, the author or narrator of the Bhāgavata.
3 The minister of RĀVAṆA.
4 The Śirīṣa tree.
5 A plant, commonly Seyālkānta.
n. (-कं)
1 A drug and perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
2 Cloth, clothes.
3 The ends or hem of a cloth.
4 A turban, a helmet.
5 A plant, [] (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
शुभ to shine, कक् Uṇādi aff., and the radical final rejected.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The awn of barley, &c.
2 A bristle, a spicula.
3 Compassion, clemency, tenderness.
f. (-का)
Cowach.
E.
शो to make sharp or thin, ऊक aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
1 Air, wind.
2 An arrow.
3 A lotus.
E.
षू to bring forth, क्विप् affix, and कन् added.

n. (-दं)
A fragrant root, of which various kinds are said to be known.
E.
शुक a parrot, and च्छद a cover or wing.

f. (-ह्वा)
A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta or parrot's beak.
E.
शुक a parrot, and जिह्वा the tongue.

m. (-रुः)
The Śirīṣa, (Acacia Sirisha.)
E.
शुक the same, and तरु a tree.

m. (-वः)
The son of VYĀSA; see शुक.
E.
शुक, and देव divine.

m. (-मः)
The Śirīṣa tree: see the last.

f. (-मा)
A plant; see शुकजिह्वा.

m. (-सः)
1 A tree, (Bignonia Indica.)
2 Another tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
E.
शुक, and नास the nose, the flowers being compared to a parrot's beak.

m. (-हः)
The sage PARĀŚARA, father of VYĀSA, and grandfather of ŚUKA.

m. (-च्छः)
Sulphur.
E.
शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail; of similar colour.

n. (-कं)
A perfume and medicinal root, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
E.
शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail, कन् aff. of comparison.

f. (-या)
The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.)
E.
शुक a parrot, and प्रिया beloved.

ind.
Quickly.

n. (-ह)
Ganṭhiāla, a perfume.
E.
शुक a parrot, and वर्ह a tail.

m. (-भः)
The pomegranate.
E.
शुक a parrot, and वल्लभ beloved.

m. (-हः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
शुक a parrot, and वाह who is borne.

m. (-नः)
The pomegranate.
E.
शुक a parrot, and अदन eating.

f. (-ना)
A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta.
E.
शुक a parrot, and आनन the face.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Sour, acid.
2 Pure, clean.
3 Harsh, hard.
n. (-क्तं)
1 Flesh.
2 Sour-gruel.
3 Vinegar, acid, or an acid preparation made from roots or fruits, by steeping them in oil and salt, drying them, and then leaving them in water, where they undergo the acetous fermentation: the fluid produce is used as vinegar.
4 Crabbed or harsh speech.
5 A hymn of the Vedas.
f. (-क्ता)
A sort of sorrel.
E.
शुच to be pure, &c., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Well or properly said.
n. (-क्तं)
A hymn in the Ṛk Veda.
f. (-क्ता)
The Śārika or Maina.
E.
सु well, उक्त spoken, (by which.)

f. (-क्तिः)
1 A pearl oyster.
2 A conch.
3 A small shell.
4 A cockle.
5 A sort of perfume, in appearance a dried shell fish.
6 A portion of the skull used as a cup, &c.
7 A curl or feather on a horse's neck or breast.
8 A weight of two Karṣas or half a Pala. A disease of the cornea, formation of specks on it.
E.
शुच् to sorrow, &c., aff. क्तिच्.

f. (-का)
1 A pearl oyster.
2 A sort of dock or sorrel.
E.
शुक्ति as above, or शुक्त sour, कन् added, fem. form.

n. (-जं)
A pearl.
E.
शुक्ति the oyster, and ज born.

n. (-टं)
The pearl oyster shell.
E.
शुक्ति, and पुट a bag or sheathe

f. (-शी)
The envelope of the pearl or pearl oyster shell.
E.
शुक्ति, and पेशी a covering.

f. (-धूः)
Mother of pearl or the pearl oyster.
E.
शुक्ति, and बधू wife or female; in which the pearl, it is supposed, is bred.

m. (-मान्)
One of the seven principal mountains or mountainous ranges of India.
E.
शुक्ति a pearl oyster, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-जं)
A pearl.
E.
शुक्ति the oyster, and वीज a seed.

m. (-र्शः)
Dusky spots on a pearl, causing it to be of little value.
E.
शुक्ति a pearl, and स्पर्श contact.

m. (-क्रः)
1 The planet VENUS or its regent, the son of BHṚGU, and preceptor of the Daityas or Titans.
2 A name of fire.
3 The month Jyeṣṭha, (April-May.)
n. (-क्रं)
1 Semen virile.
2 A morbid affection of the iris, change of colour, ulceration, &c. accompanied by imperfect vision.
E.
शुच् to grieve, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Producing semen, spermatic.
m. (-रः)
The marrow of the bones.
E.
शुक्र seed, and कर what makes.

m. (-भुक्)
A peacock.
E.
शुक्र semen, भुज to eat, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-भूः)
The marrow of the bones.
E.
शुक्र semen, and भू being.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Spermatic, augmenting the seminal secretion.
f. (-ला)
A fragrant grass, considered by some as a sort of Cyperus, and by others, Zedoary.
E.
शुक्र semen, and लच् aff., or ला to get or give, aff. क.

m. (-रः)
Friday.
E.
शुक्र ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS, or the planet, and वार a day.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Sacred to ŚUKRA, &c.
E.
शुक्र as above, and घन् aff.

f. (-या)
1 A good action, a good work; a moral or religious observance.
E.
सु, and क्रिया act.

m. (-ष्यः)
A demon, a Titan, a powerful being opposed to the gods.
E.
शुक्र the teacher of this race, and शिष्य a pupil.

m. (-र्य्यः)
The regent of VENUS.
E.
शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.

mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं)
White, of a white colour.
m. (-क्लः)
1 White, (the colour.)
2 One of the astronomical Yogas.
n. (-क्लं)
1 Silver.
2 Fresh butter.
3 A disease of the cornea, opacity, albugo.
m. (-क्लः)
One half of a month: see शुक्लपक्ष.
f. (-क्ला)
1 A name of SARASVATĪ.
2 Clayed or candied sugar.
E.
शुच to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, and र changed to ल.

m. (-कः)
A kind of gallinule or water-hen.
E.
शुक्ल white, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Innocent, virtuous.
E.
शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-त्वं)
Whiteness.
E.
शुक्ल white, and त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. शुक्लता.

m. (-ग्धः)
An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
E.
शुक्ल white, दुग्ध milk.

m. (-तुः)
Chalk.
E.
शुक्ल white, and धातु a mineral.

m. (-क्षः)
The light half of a month, the fifteen days of the moon's increase, or from new to full moon.
E.
शुक्ल white, and पक्ष part or fortnight.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 The white variety of Amaranth, (Gomphrœna globosa.)
2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) []
f. (-ष्पा)
1 A shrub, (Phrynium dichotomum.)
2 A sort of sun-flower.
E.
शुक्ल white, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-कः)
A small tree, (Vitex nigundo.)

m. (-लः)
A name, common to nine persons peculiar to the Jainas.
E.
शुक्ल white, and बल a BALADEVA, there being nine white BALADEVAS, corresponding to the nine KṚṢṆAS, or black VĀSUDEVAS, according to the notions of this sect.

n. (-लं)
The white of the eye, the cornea.
E.
शुक्ल white, and मण्डल a circle.

m. (-र्गः)
1 A class of white objects, or the conch, pearloyster, and cowrie, &c.
E.
शुक्ल white, and वर्ग a class.

m. (-सः)
A crane.
E.
शुक्ल white, and वायस a crow.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Having a white body or limbs.
m. (-ङ्गः)
A peacock.
E.
शुक्ल white, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A peacock.
E.
शुक्ल white, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye.

m. (-मा)
Whiteness.
E.
शुक्ल white, and इमनिच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Whitening, making white.
E.
शुक्ल, and करण making, च्चि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made white, whitened.
E.
शुक्ल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.

f. (-ला)
1 Clayed or candied sugar.
2 Any white stone.
E.
शुक्ल white, and उपला a stone.

m. (-क्षिः)
Air, wind.
E.
शुष to dry up, Uṇādi aff. क्षि.

m. (-कः)
1 Barley, or a bearded kind of wheat resembling it.
2 The sentiment of compassion or tenderness.
E.
कन added to the last.

m. (-टः)
A caterpillar.
E.
शूक a bristle, (the hairs on the insect,) and कीट a worm; also with कन् added शूककीटक.

n. (-णं)
A kind of grass.
E.
शूक an awn, and तृण grass.

n. (-न्यं)
Awned or bearded grain, as barley, &c.
E.
शूक an awn, and धान्य grain.

f. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
शूक an awn, and पिण्डि a heap.

m. (-रः)
A hog.
f. (-री)
1 A kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum.)
2 A sow.
E.
शूक an awn, (a bristle,) र aff., or शू imitative sound, कृ to make, with अच् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Easy, practicable, attainable.
2 Doing well or becomingly.
n. (-रं)
Doing good to, charity, benevolence.
f. (-रा)
A tractable cow.
E.
सु pleasure, कृ to make or confer, खल् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A hog.
2 A potter.
3 A sort of deer, (the hog deer.)
f. (-री)
A sort of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum.)
E.
स substituted for श; see शूकर.

f. (-न्ता)
A kind of moss, &c.: see the last; also वराहक्रान्ता.

m. (-लः)
A restive horse.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Liberal, both in giving and using.
E.
सु good, कल to call, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Awned, bearded.
f. (-ती)
Cowach.
E.
शूक an awn, मतुप् aff.

f. (-म्बा)
Cowach.
E.
शूक an awn, and शिम्बा a pod.

f. (-म्बिः-म्बी)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
शूक an awn, and शिम्बि a pod; also with कन् added शूकशिम्बिका.

m. (-ट्टः)
A gem, perhaps amber.
E.
शूक an awn, आङ् before पुट्ट to become small, अच् aff.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Awned, bearded, (as grain.)
E.
शूक, and इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A fish in general.
2 A kind of fish.
3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)

mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं)
Minute, small, fine, subtile.
m. (-क्ष्मः)
1 Fraud, dishonesty.
2 Universal spirit.
E.
स substituted for श in the more correct form सूक्ष्म, q. v.

mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं)
1 Little, small.
2 Minute, atomic.
3 Fine, delicate.
4 Ingenious, subtle.
m. (-क्ष्मः)
1 An atom.
2 Clearingnut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.)
n. (-ह्यं)
1 The Supreme Soul, the subtle and invisible spirit that pervades all existence.
2 Fraud, cheating.
3 Fine thread, &c.
4 A figure of rhetoric, the delicate or subtle expression of act or intention.
5 Subtlety, ingenuity, craft.
f. (-क्ष्मा)
1 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
2 Small cardamoms.
3 A perfume, consisting of a substance in small grains: see Elavāluka.
E.
सूच् to inform or make known, स्मन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-का)
The Aloe plant.
E.
सु good or much, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-ण्डुः)
Psora, itch.
E.
सु much, कण्डु the same disease.

m. (-न्दः)
1 The onion.
2 A yam.
3 A sort of grass, (Scirpus kyssoor.)
4 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.)
E.
सु good, excellent, and कन्द a root.

m. (-कः)
An onion.
E.
सु good, कन्द a root, and कन् added.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
सु good, कर्ण an ear, कन् aff. of comparison, and fem. form.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
1 Virtuous, good, acting virtuously, doing what is right and fit.
2 Active, diligent.
m. (-र्म्मा)
1 The artist or architect of the gods.
2 One of the astronomical Yogas.
E.
सु good, कर्म्मन् act, action.

m. (-ण्डी)
A bee.
E.
सु good, काण्ड a shrub, and इनि aff.

m. (-ली)
A progenitor of a particular class considered as those of the Śūdra tribe.
E.
सु good, काल time, इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
An onion; also सुकन्दक, मुकुन्दक, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Soft, smooth, tender.
2 Youthful, young.
m. (-रः)
A variety of the sugar-cane.
3 A sort of grain, (Panicum colonum, &c.)
4 A wild kind of Champak.
5 The name of a Daitya.
f. (-रा)
1 Double jasmine.
2 Great-flowered jasmine.
3 The plantain.
4 The name of a river.
E.
सु very, exceedingly, कुमार soft, young.

mfn. (-कृत्)
1 Virtuous, pious.
2 Fortunate, well-fated.
E.
सु well, कृत् who does.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Virtuous, pious.
2 Befriended, assisted, treated with kindness.
3 Fortunate, auspicious.
4 Done well, properly, ably, &c.
n. (-तं)
1 Virtue, moral merit.
2 Fortune, auspiciousness.
3 Kindness, bounty, friendly aid or assistance.
4 Any kind or friendly act.
5 Reward, recompense, especially heaven as the reward of virtue.
E.
सु well, and कृत made or done.

f. (-तिः)
1 Virtue, well-doing.
2 Kindness, acting in a friendly or kindly manner.
3 The practice of religious austerities, &c.
E.
सु good, and कृति action.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Fortunate, well-fated.
2 Virtuous, pious, good.
3 Benign, benevolent.
4 Learned, wise.
E.
सुकृत auspiciousness, &c. इनि poss. aff.

f. (-ली)
A medicinal root, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.

n. (-णं)
Disrespect.
E.
सूक्ष to disrespect, aff. ल्युट्, and the र rejected; also सूर्क्षण.

f. (-ला)
1 Long-pepper.
2 A sort of grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
सूक्ष्म fine, तण्डुला grain.

n. (-त्वं)
Fineness, subtilty.
E.
सूक्ष्म, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सूक्ष्मता.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Acute, quick, sharp-sighted, intelligent.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, fine, and दर्शिन् who sees.

m. (-रुः)
A thin plank of wood.
E.
सूक्ष्म fine, small, and दारु wood.

m. (-चः)
1 Coriander seed.
2 A wild kind of cumin.
3 A sort of mustard.
4 A red sort of sugar-cane.
5 The gum Arabic tree, (Mimosa Arabica.)
E.
सूक्ष्म fine, small, and पच a leaf.

f. (-र्णी)
Rāmadūtī, a plant so called.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, and पर्ण a leaf.

f. (-ला)
A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
E.
सूक्ष्म small, and फल a fruit.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
1 Sharp, shrewd, intelligent, acute.
f. (-द्धिः)
Mental acumen.
E.
सूक्ष्म, and बुद्धि understanding^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-का)
A musquito, a gnat.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, and मक्षिका a fly.

n. (-स्त्रं)
Fine cloth.
E.
सूक्ष्म fine, वस्त्र cloth.

n. (-रं)
The subtle body invested by and the archetype of the grosser and perceptible frame.
E.
सूक्ष्म, and शरीर body.

m. (-लिः)
A small and fine kind of rice.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, and शालि rice.

m. (-णः)
A sort of tick or louse breeding at the roots of the eye-lashes.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, and षद्परण an insect.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made thin or minute.
E.
सूक्ष्म, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become fine, subtle, minute.
E.
सूक्ष्म, भूत become, and च्चि augment.
